---
title: "Architectures and service boundaries"
---

*Sample chapter for the proposed course plan.*

## Learning outcome

Identify a service boundary and its communication costs.

**Prerequisites:** Lecture 01.

## Core idea

Splitting an application into services introduces communication between independently running components. A useful boundary groups related responsibilities, but calls across that boundary add latency and new failure cases.

## Worked scenario

The registration service asks a separate catalogue service whether a course exists. Catalogue unavailability can now affect registration.

## Discussion

Which information could registration cache, and when would that cache become unsafe?

## Recap

Service boundaries should be evaluated against both responsibilities and failure behaviour.
